_meta: 영어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 미국 말투 한 벌. 여성판 이름은 고정 인물 Emma 와 겹치지 않게 Sara. 2026-11-07 사용자 청취 "감정 과잉, 특히 남자" → 지시를 약하게 고침, PC 폴더 ref_en2·en2.
base_text: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I got everything ready this morning. When it's over, let's grab dinner together, okay?

am.desc: A young American man in his twenties, ordinary relaxed speaking voice, low energy, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

af.desc: A young American woman in her twenties, clear and soft voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

maya.desc: An American woman in her early twenties from New York, quick and bright voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

emma.desc: An American woman in her early twenties, calm, soft and slightly teasing voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

jake.desc: An American man in his mid twenties, relaxed, laid-back and slightly deep voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

daniel.desc: An American man in his mid twenties, direct, steady and warm low voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

man_y.desc: An American man around twenty, natural and clear voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

man_m.desc: An American man in his forties from New York, flat and dry speaking voice, low energy, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

man_o.desc: An American man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

woman_y.desc: An American woman around twenty, natural and clear voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

woman_m.desc: An American woman in her forties, composed and kind voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

woman_o.desc: An American woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

kid.desc: An American child around eight years old, small and bright voice, low-key natural delivery, not theatrical

announce.desc: A clear, even female announcer voice, like a subway or airport announcement

robot.desc: A flat synthetic machine voice, like a kiosk or payment terminal

neutral.instruct: plain everyday conversation, flat and relaxed, no acting at all, understated American delivery
neutral.ref: I have a meeting this afternoon, so I got everything ready this morning.

polite.instruct: plain and polite, like a clerk at work, no extra warmth, understated American delivery
polite.ref: Good afternoon. Your order is ready. Please let me know if you need anything else.

stiff.instruct: a little tense, slightly formal, still natural, understated American delivery
stiff.ref: Thank you very much for your time today. I will do my very best. It is an honor to be here.

cheerful.instruct: lightly friendly, a small smile in the voice, not bubbly, understated American delivery
cheerful.ref: Oh, you made it! The weather is so nice, today is going to be a great day.

amused.instruct: quietly amused, a slight smile, no laughing, understated American delivery
amused.ref: Ha, that's so funny! Okay, okay, keep going, I want to hear the rest.

teasing.instruct: dry and lightly teasing, understated, understated American delivery
teasing.ref: Oh really? You just happened to be here? Sure you did. I totally believe you.

excited.instruct: mildly pleased and a bit faster, not loud, understated American delivery
excited.ref: No way, we actually got the tickets! This is the best thing that has ever happened!

surprised.instruct: mildly surprised, a small rise in pitch, not gasping, understated American delivery
surprised.ref: Wait, what? You're telling me this was here the whole time? I had no idea!

shout.instruct: raising the voice slightly to be heard, not yelling, understated American delivery
shout.ref: Hey! Stop right there! You forgot your bag! Come back!

tsukkomi.instruct: dry, deadpan pushback, not loud, understated American delivery
tsukkomi.ref: Are you serious right now? That is not even close to what I said!

annoyed.instruct: slightly tired and flat, not angry, understated American delivery
annoyed.ref: This is the third time today. Can you please just put it back where it was?

sad.instruct: a little quiet and low, not crying, understated American delivery
sad.ref: I thought it would be different this time. I guess it doesn't really matter anymore.

worried.instruct: slightly unsure, a little quieter, not panicked, understated American delivery
worried.ref: Are you okay? You haven't answered all day, and I really don't know what to do.

flustered.instruct: a little awkward and rushed, not panicked, understated American delivery
flustered.ref: No, no, that's not what I meant! I was just, I mean, can we forget I said that?

shy.instruct: soft and a little hesitant, not whispering, understated American delivery
shy.ref: I don't know how to say this. I just, um, I kind of like being around you.

gentle.instruct: soft and calm, not breathy, understated American delivery
gentle.ref: Hey, it's okay. Take your time. I'm not going anywhere, I'll wait right here.
